definitions: The act of intentionally following an order or rule to the letter, knowing that doing so will cause a negative or unintended outcome, often to highlight the absurdity or impracticality of the order itself.
A situation where an individual or group adheres strictly to instructions, despite foreseeing or even intending detrimental consequences, typically as a form of protest or passive aggression.
examples: The team engaged in malicious compliance, strictly following the outdated protocol.
Her malicious compliance with the new policy led to a significant slowdown in productivity.
It was a clear case of malicious compliance when he only worked during his exact hours, leaving tasks unfinished.
